steps.en: Install and configure Apple authentication, SDK and device connection
steps.zh: 安装并配置苹果认证、开发包及设备连接

steps.en: Create a SwiftPM app and set its bundle identifier
steps.zh: 创建 SwiftPM 应用并设置包标识

steps.en: Edit Swift code and request a device build
steps.zh: 修改 Swift 代码并请求真机构建

steps.en: Build products and assemble the app bundle
steps.zh: 构建产物并组装应用包

steps.en: Use Apple signing services and install on the paired device
steps.zh: 使用苹果签名服务并安装到已配对设备

value.en: A SwiftPM application reaches your iOS device without maintaining an Xcode project
value.zh: 无需维护 Xcode 项目，即可把 SwiftPM 应用装到 iOS 真机
